frequency_question: How often has the statistical agency successfully completed the data collection, compilation, and scheduled publication of the advance quarterly GDP estimate on its designated release date without a processing failure or calendar disruption?
membership_rule: Includes all scheduled quarterly advance GDP estimate releases by the BEA from Q1 2014 through Q2 2026. Excludes revised estimates (second or third estimates) and annual revisions.
coverage_note: 11 named consecutive quarters representing the most recent operational baseline; historical adherence over a 10-year window exceeds 40 consecutive quarters.
known_gaps: None; the BEA release schedule operates under strict statutory and administrative timelines with zero missed advance estimate publications due to process failure.
skeleton: 11 quarters evaluated across the recent multi-year window representing the exact operational pipeline required for the Q3 2026 release.
multiplier: 11 successful scheduled process completions / 11 scheduled releases
validity_reason: The operational cadence, statutory reporting windows, and data collection pipelines of the statistical agency remain stable on an annual basis.
